# AGENTS.md

For humans and AI agents working on **{{PROJECT_NAME}}**. Work items live in-tree under `ArggonManager/`, managed by `arggon`; GitHub is for PRs only — never open GitHub issues.

> **Use the `arggon-cli` skill by default** (`.agents/skills/arggon-cli/SKILL.md`). OpenCode V2's native `arggon` tools and `/arggon-*` commands ship with its seam (`arggon init` default); without it the CLI alone is complete.

## Task workflow

<!-- arggon:workflow-copy:start -->
<!-- Generated by npm run workflow:sync; edit ArggonManager/docs/agents.md instead. -->
Follow the [canonical workflow contract](https://github.com/Arggon/ArggonManager/blob/main/ArggonManager/docs/agents.md#canonical-workflow-contract) for claiming and completing work.
<!-- arggon:workflow-copy:end -->

Tools: `/arggon-next`, `/arggon-start`; `tools.arggon.next`, `tools.arggon.start`, `tools.arggon.create`, `tools.arggon.comment`, `tools.arggon.cleanup`. **Never steal a claim**; **Never reopen** `done`/`cancelled`.

### Orchestration

Delegated by default: the **delivery lead** assigns each item to a subagent (one per worktree), planning waves by file-disjointness, and **code-reviews every subagent change against the project's own bar** before merge — green CI is necessary, not sufficient. Verdicts land on the item via `tools.arggon.comment` — never as GitHub PR comments. Subagents follow the same rules and report findings to the delivery lead instead of filing tracker items.
